title: Husky Ltee
description: huskyboutique.com zoominfo.com/c/husky-ltée/457918337 Husky (Chaussures HUSKY Ltée) is a Quebec family-owned workwear and safety footwear retailer founded in 1969 in Joliette by Jean-Louis Drainville, now run by the third generation (CEO François Drainville, President Hugo Drainville). It employs ~15–50 people from its Saint-Paul headquarters, with estimated revenue of $5–15M/year (private, self-funded). Core business: retail and B2B sales of work boots, safety apparel, and PPE (Carhartt, Ariat, Timberland, Helly Hansen, Big Bill), plus an in-house atelier producing 50,000+ custom embroideries, prints, and promotional products per year for corporate clients. Its signature service is the HUSKY Mobile Store (since 1985) — a fully equipped truck that travels to job sites and factories for on-site employee fittings.
